PawnIO 2.2.0
============

LAN PC Monitor redistributes the official, unmodified PawnIO setup program so
LibreHardwareMonitor can access low-level CPU and motherboard sensors on modern
Windows systems.

Project and corresponding source code:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO

Official setup release:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0

Bundled file: PawnIO_setup.exe
SHA-256: 1f519a22e47187f70a1379a48ca604981c4fcf694f4e65b734aaa74a9fba3032

PawnIO is licensed separately under GPL-2.0-or-later with the exception stated
in COPYING.txt. It is not part of LAN PC Monitor's MIT-licensed source code.

The driver is a shared system dependency and is intentionally left installed
when LAN PC Monitor is removed, because another hardware-monitoring application
may also use it.
